0.description: As you have no doubt noticed, the Starlight Celebration is in full swing. Would you like to join the festivities? Amh Garanjy is in Gridania looking for more little helpers!
0.translation_description: La Celebrazione delle Stelle è in pieno svolgimento. Ti va di partecipare ai festeggiamenti? Amh Garanjy cerca altri piccoli aiutanti a Gridania!

1.name: TEXT_FESXMS2017MOUNT_00439_COMMITTEE00439_000_010
1.description: You can leave trussing up the treants and recovering the stolen decorations to us. All you need to do is ride <hex:020968E948FF074B6F63686162FF18020814E905FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C6172697303FF08506665726B6164FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C61726973FF18020814E905FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C6172697303FF08506F6C61726973FF074B6F6368616203> and give those thieves a face full of starburst!
1.translation_description: Puoi lasciare a noi il compito di immobilizzare i treant e recuperare gli addobbi rubati. A te basta cavalcare <hex:020968E948FF074B6F63686162FF18020814E905FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C6172697303FF08506665726B6164FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C61726973FF18020814E905FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C6172697303FF08506F6C61726973FF074B6F6368616203> e sparare una raffica di esplosioni stellari in faccia a quei ladri!

2.name: TEXT_FESXMS2017MOUNT_00439_COMMITTEE00439_000_020
2.translation_description: Ti va di dare la caccia ad altri treant ladruncoli? La tua cavalcatura <hex:020968E948FF074B6F63686162FF18020814E905FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C6172697303FF08506665726B6164FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C61726973FF18020814E905FF074B6F63686162FF08506F6C6172697303FF08506F6C61726973FF074B6F6368616203> è pronta a partire!
